summary: Retested the iter25 fixes. Backend: the new test_iter26_retest_fixes.py passed 6 of 7 tests. The 1 failure is a new finding outside the requested scope. The updated test_iter25 suite passed 25 of 25 after I changed TestTrip to cover the 2 h start guard. All 8 requested items pass: suspended driver cannot go online (400); resubmitting with place=null in the same taluk keeps home.geo, loc_id and place_name (a different taluk drops geo); a flagged licence_back must be re-uploaded (exact 400 message), then submit succeeds; start more than 2 h before (and at 2h10m) gives 400, at 1h50m gives 200; migration keeps a 'rejected' vehicle and sets a 'none' vehicle to approved. UI at 390px: dash-service-book is unchecked and dimmed with 'Needs an approved vehicle' when book_ready=false and services has 'book'; pro-error clears on the next input change, for both the backend error and the step check; the VehicleForm Make/Model row fits (158px each, no horizontal scroll); the admin pro status badge is not clipped; /hire Book shows only HATCHBACK/SEDAN/SUV/MUV/ANY, and the choice resets to SEDAN after switching from Rent with LUXURY picked.

minor.issue: Local-only drivers (no carpool driver_status) are never locked. The lock checks users.driver_status in LOCKED_STATUSES, not pro_drivers.status. An approved or under_review local driver can replace licence_front, licence_back or id_proof at any time. Single-file kinds soft-delete the old verified file, so the verified photo can be swapped without a new review. It also means flagged-only uploads during resubmit are not enforced for these drivers: licence_front upload returned 200 when only licence_back was flagged. The new re-upload check in pro_register still works.
The rate limit (5 per 15 min per email and IP) also counts successful logins, so test runs lock admin login. I deleted only the 2 adminlogin rate_limits keys my runs created.

integration_issues.issue: Continue moves on even when a flagged doc (pro-flag-licence_back) was not re-uploaded. The driver only sees 'Please upload a new photo for: Driving licence (back)' on step 3 after Submit, and must go back. Add the same check in check() for step 1 (compare file created_at with profile.reviewed_at).

issues: The disabled Book card uses opacity 0.55, so the orange note 'Needs an approved vehicle' has low contrast on the grey card

action_items: Lock local-driver doc uploads by pro_drivers.status: block licence_front, licence_back and id_proof when the profile is under_review or approved, and allow only the resubmit_items when it is resubmit or rejected. Today the lock uses only the carpool users.driver_status.
Optional: in register.tsx step 1, block Continue until the flagged doc kinds are re-uploaded.
Optional: do not count successful admin logins toward the admin login rate limit.
critical_code_review_comments: pro_unlocked and LOCKED_STATUSES depend on carpool driver_status. A pure local driver bypasses the locks completely (see action item 1).
The hire start guard uses h['starts_at'].replace(tzinfo=utc). This is fine for naive UTC from Mongo. 'complete' has no time guard, but that is acceptable because it needs 'started'.
server.py is very large (more than 3900 lines). The local-driver routes should be split into their own module.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter25_local_driver_redesign.py (TestTrip now checks the 400 when early, then sets starts_at to now+90min and checks start gives 200)

success_rate.backend: 100% of the requested fixes (31/32 tests pass; the 1 failure is a new finding about the upload lock)

seed_data_creation: Only TEST_ users, vehicles and hires, plus user_TEST_mig26. All were deleted by their ids or by the uids saved in state. I deleted the adminlogin rate_limits keys (2 keys, 11 entries) that my runs created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_iter26_retest_fixes.py -c /dev/null -p no:xdist -v (it uses helpers from test_iter25), and the same for test_iter25_local_driver_redesign.py. test_local_only_docs_locked_when_approved fails on purpose until the upload lock is fixed. Each suite logs in as admin once and the 5-per-15-min limit counts successful logins too, so you may need to delete the adminlogin:* rate_limits keys. UI: python ui_setup_iter26.py create|cleanup (/tmp/ui26.json; drv = approved with a pending vehicle, res = resubmit with licence_back flagged; password Passw0rd!x). On /hire you first click the 'BOOK A DRIVER' text card, and then the hire-service-tab-* chips appear. The frontend URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env.
